edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into local _pusher which keys the pusher queue.
msg.sender is compared to tx.origin inside the isHuman modifier.
tx.origin is read by isHuman to gate the caller.
isHuman modifier guards entry into distribute.
block.timestamp (now) drives the one hour greed check and event packing in distribute.
Global pusherTracker_ is read to evaluate pusher greed.
pushers_ mapping entries are read for tracker and time checks.
distribute writes updated tracker and timestamp back into pushers_.
distribute advances the global pusherTracker_ state variable.
Caller supplied _percent controls the sell threshold and event data.
Local _bal (full contract balance) is forwarded as value to the external buy call.
msg.sender derived _pusher is passed as the buyer to the external H4D contract.
distribute performs an external payable call before finalizing state.
distribute calls the external sell on H4D, an untrusted interaction.
distribute calls external reinvest repeatedly inside an unbounded while loop.
distribute calls external withdraw on H4D after the loop.
distribute performs a raw unchecked increment on pusherTracker_.
External buy on H4D can re-enter this contract's payable fallback with ether.
External sell on H4D triggers value transfer that may re-enter the fallback.
External reinvest sends dividends and can call back into the fallback.
External withdraw sends ether and can invoke the contract fallback.

_input parameter is consumed by extract.

_position parameter is passed into exponent.
exponent calls SafeMath.pwr for exponentiation.
pwr multiplies repeatedly through SafeMath.mul.
sqrt uses SafeMath.add in its Newton iteration.
sq multiplies via SafeMath.mul.
